lines.text: He remembers me. Eight years in Alupotha and he still calls me Teacher Kamala. It is the most efficient form of social recognition I have encountered.

lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: Your polling division has changed. New assignment this cycle. Different station from last time.

lines.prompt: You assumed you were going to the same polling station as always.

choices.label: "I know where to go,  I always vote at Rivisanda school."
